title: Chumash daily-aliyah boundaries
description: One reading per single parsha or doubled parsha (Vezot HaBracha included as a single parsha too — read on Simchat Torah, never on a normal Shabbat). Each carries the book (1=Genesis..5=Deuteronomy) and seven aliyah ranges in chapter:verse-chapter:verse format.

parshiyot.description: 1 or 2 Parsha keys covered by this reading.

aliyot.description: Common (Ashkenaz-flavour) Shabbat 7 aliyot: aliyot 1-3 from opentorah <aliyah> tags, 4-7 from <day> defaults.

aliyotChabad.description: Chabad Shabbat 7 aliyot (= chumash-yomi day boundaries), from opentorah <day> tags with custom="Chabad" overrides. Present only when different from `aliyot`.
